_comment: Compose with: node tools/screenshots/compose.mjs apps/solitaire/store/screenshots.json apps/solitaire/store/screenshots/en-US. Raw captures come from verify-app.sh reading qa.json, into store/raw. The diary leads, per the spec's 4.3 note that the listing must open on the day written down and the deal's number, never a bare card table like the other forty-six solitaires. The frame is the app's own baize going to lamp-lit night, walnut-free, with brass as the tint; the font is the app's New York. Titles are the three wedges in order: every deal comes out, no ads, no internet.
